android.sdk_name: Google Maps SDK for Android + Maps Compose
android.api_key_handling: Gradle BuildConfig / manifestPlaceholders injection from local.properties or MAPS_API_KEY env var with graceful unconfigured fallback
android.billing_requirement: Google Cloud Platform Project with Maps SDK for Android and billing enabled
android.graceful_degradation: When Maps API key is blank or invalid, MapScreen displays a calm Native Map Provider Unavailable state card instead of crashing

ios.third_party_dependencies: NONE (0 external packages, 100% native Apple framework)
ios.billing_requirement: Included with standard Apple Developer Program membership (no per-tile billing for native MapKit views)
